SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio,
  AVG(line_item_count) as avg_line_items_per_order_item
FROM (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 
             THEN CAST(derived_product_cost AS REAL) / CAST(derived_total_cost AS REAL)
             ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)    -- the overall average ratio is ~2.218 and average of ~1.364 line items per order item
